sivatherium.definition:
n. A genus of very large extinct ruminants found in the
   Tertiary formation of India. The snout was prolonged in the form of a
   proboscis. The male had four horns, the posterior pair being large and
   branched. It was allied to the antelopes, but very much larger than any
   exsisting species.
